pages.text: On first level gives +1 Bravery, +3 Clumsyness, +2 Mana Drain and +1 Alchohol, then for each subsequent level gives +1 of each of those effects. Gives increasingly strong Poison once level is 4 or above, and increasingly strong damage upon reaching level 7. Gives 15 seconds of Nausea, Weakness and Mining Fatigue on effect end.
